question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Head in the clouds
solution:
The correct answer is **"Being absent minded."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom** "head in the clouds"** means that someone is not paying attention to their surroundings or is daydreaming. (कोई अपने परिवेश पर ध्यान नहीं दे रहा है या दिवास्वप्न देख रहा है)

 
 
• Example:* He's always got his **head in the clouds__** during meetings, so he never contributes anything useful.*
 
 
 
• The phrase can also imply that someone is unrealistic or impractical in their thinking.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
